description: Dependency updates, per ADR-0102. Renovate opens the pull request, and the CI gate decides. It merges nothing.
The nix manager and the weekly lock file maintenance keep flake.lock current, so no pin goes stale.

packageRules.description: A major version is a decision, so it is proposed alone and never joins a group.
Minor and patch updates of the pinned inputs and Actions come in one pull request.

msw 3 no longer intercepts the fetch of Bun, and msw supports only Node.js. On 2026-11-21, msw 3.0.7 on Bun 1.4.5 still let a request reach the network. The frontend tests run on Bun, per ADR-0400. So msw waits below 3 until a release intercepts it again.

customManagers.description: An image that a script starts outside the cluster, such as the host registry, is a NAME_IMAGE variable in scripts/lib. No other manager reads a shell script.
